correctness.rationale: The stationary telegraph coherence solves Gʺ+2ξGʹ+4ν²G=0 with G(0)=1,Gʹ(0)=0, giving e^{−ξt}[cos δt+(ξ/δ)sin δt], δ=sqrt(4ν²−ξ²). An x-pulse converts the pre-pulse Bloch y component G(t)sin ωt to conserved z, while conditional transverse modes decay, giving terminal ensemble capacity 2ε|E[G(T)sin(ωT)sin2θ(T)]|. Fixed θ optimizes outside expectation; informed θ(T) can select the sign inside, not the telegraph state. A globally Lipschitz slow envelope h(t)=e^{−ξt}sin ωt1_{t>=0}, maximized at t_H, and Gaussian characteristic filtering yield uniformly B/(2ε)=H e^{−(δσ)²/2}+O(σ+δ^−2) for σ→0; analogous F/(2ε)=H b(δσ)+O(σ+δ^−2). Fourier |cos| gives b(s)→2/π as s→∞, while uniform integration-by-parts for fixed σ yields blind zero and informed positive smoothed-envelope limit. Independently checked exact slow envelope and nearest rapid-phase peaks for ν=10,30,100 at ξ=ω=1; deterministic tests only corroborate analytic bounds.
